description: Official package registry for the Lapia Pygame engine. Install from the built-in Terminal with: pip install <name>

packages.name: lapia-kit
packages.author: all-in-onen-engine
packages.description: Core engine helpers: screen shake, timers, tweens, sprite pooling and camera utilities.

packages.name: ally-kernel
packages.author: ally-ai
packages.description: Ally-5 runtime kernel — the local game-generation model the AI assistant runs on. Pre-installed.

packages.name: sfx-kit
packages.author: all-in-onen-engine
packages.description: Synthesized sound effects for the desktop engine: jumps, coins, explosions, UI blips. Zero audio files.

packages.name: sprite-kit
packages.author: all-in-onen-engine
packages.description: Sprite sheet slicing, animation state machines and pixel-perfect collision helpers.

packages.name: level-kit
packages.author: all-in-onen-engine
packages.description: Tilemap loader, procedural level generation (platformer caves, rooms, mazes) and spawn markers.

packages.name: particles-kit
packages.author: ally-ai
packages.description: Juicy particle systems: bursts, trails, confetti, explosions and weather effects.

packages.name: pygame
packages.author: pygame community
packages.description: The real desktop pygame (SDL bindings) — used by the Python engine outside the browser sandbox.

packages.name: numpy
packages.author: numpy developers
packages.description: Fast arrays and math — pre-installed in the browser Pyodide runtime.
